Discovered by chance in the street when hearing a man speaking French. This is the owner of the restaurant we decide to go to. 
The premises are small, very well maintained, the atmosphere is very pleasant. 
It is typical Vietnamese cuisine, made with fresh and quality products.

Charming local restaurant with great Vietnamese food
Jan 2026 • Couples
Having read great reviews on Tripadvisor we decided to go for dinner on a Friday evening without booking. We arrived at about 6pm and were greeted very pleasantly by a young lady ( possibly Luli's daughter). We were quickly shown to a table for two on the upper level and given menus. The lady mentioned that her mum cooked from her grandmother's recipes
 Our main server was another very pleasant young lady who made helpful menu suggestion and chatted to us about our trip. We ordered three items from the menu which came promptly and were explained. Our server helped create space for our food and drinks by adding another small table. Everything we had was as described and delicious. The attentive service ebbed a little as the restaurant filled up and the servers changed over. Highly recommended and we hope to return soon.

An amazing hidden gem!!
Aug 2025 • Family
We stumbled across Luli's Kitchen on our very first night in Ho Chi Minh City, and we’re so glad we did! We’re a family of four with two kids (ages 10 and 11), and our 10-year-old is very fussy when it comes to food. We had a few other restaurant recommendations, but they didn’t feel quite right—we wanted something truly authentic.
From the moment we walked in, the owner (a lovely woman) made us feel incredibly welcome. The food was absolutely outstanding—we honestly ate like kings and queens! We tried a wide range of dishes, and everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The beef salad is a must-try.
The biggest surprise? Even our fussy eater loved every single dish! That alone says it all.
Luli’s Kitchen is a true hidden gem—amazing quality food at a fraction of the price you’d pay back home. We highly, highly recommend it to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City

A Quiet Gem with Serious Flavour
May 2025 • Friends
We came here during our first week in Vietnam after a friendly recommendation from a nearby café—and honestly, it turned out to be one of the best meals of the trip so far.

I opted for the beef pho, and I can say that it is the type of food that stops you in your tracks. The broth was rich, layered, and full of depth—like it had been simmering perfectly for hours. 
Deep umami, a little sweetness, incredibly balanced. The beef was tender and generous, and the sauces on the side added a perfect extra kick. You can tell the people in the kitchen care—this isn’t mass-produced tourist fare. It’s food made with heart.

The atmosphere was warm and relaxed, with a kind of quiet charm that doesn’t try too hard. What really stood out was the staff—genuinely welcoming, happy to chat, and even gave us tips on other places to check out around Vietnam.

If you’re after real, traditional Vietnamese food made with love, this place is a must. Can’t recommend it enough.
